subject: Clarify: invoice-splitting & blanket resale acceptance for SmallBatch Bakery
messages:
From: Jared Morales <jared@smallbatchbakery.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Sales tax question — can blanket cover split invoices / multiple ship-tos?

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Quick question from our AP team: SmallBatch is registered for resale in NY (see attached certificate) and we use multiple shipping addresses across our bakery network. Occasionally your accounting team splits a single order into two invoices when different warehouses fulfill parts of an order. Will the blanket resale certificate we just uploaded cover both invoices automatically, or do you need us to provide additional mapping (per-ship-to) or a signed affidavit for drop-ship scenarios?

We want to avoid invoice holds if possible — can you confirm required evidence and whether we should expect invoice splitting to delay payment?

Thanks,
Jared Morales
Director of Finance | SmallBatch Bakery
attachment: SmallBatch_Resale_Certificate_NY_2026.pdf (PDF)
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jared Morales <jared@smallbatchbakery.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Sales tax question — can blanket cover split invoices / multiple ship-tos?

Hi Jared — thanks for sending the certificate. Short answer: we can accept a single NY blanket resale certificate across multiple ship-to addresses, but finance needs either (A) a ship-to mapping file that ties the certificate to the exact EIN/DBA per ship-to, or (B) a signed drop-ship affidavit that covers multi-warehouse fulfillment.

Notes for expectations:
- If an order is split into separate invoices, our billing system will check the ship-to on each invoice against the accepted evidence. If evidence exists for those ship-tos, we release to customer billing; otherwise the invoice is held pending evidence.
- Finance prefers a CSV mapping (shipto address, shipto ID, EIN, certificate id) when customers have more than 3 ship-to locations.
- For third-party drop-ship/distributor flows, we require the signed DropShip_Affidavit (notarization not always required, but signature and company letterhead are).

I'm looping in Ben and Lauren from Sales/Finance to confirm how we apply a hold and what the minimal acceptable artifact is for your setup.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sales tax question — can blanket cover split invoices / multiple ship-tos?

Hi team — finance guidance below so we can give SmallBatch a clear checklist:

1) If SmallBatch provides a certificate that explicitly lists a single legal entity (EIN) and it matches the billing entity on our side, a ship-to mapping is optional for up to 3 ship-to locations. For >3 ship-tos we require a CSV mapping file.
2) If shipments are fulfilled by a third-party warehouse or vendor (drop-ship), we require a signed DropShip affidavit (Signed_DropShip_Affidavit.pdf). If the affidavit indicates the warehouse is an agent of SmallBatch and lists the warehouse EINs, we can accept it.
3) For split invoices: Finance will only place an invoice on hold if the ship-to's tax treatment is not covered by the accepted evidence. Holds are applied per invoice; the moment evidence is uploaded and verified against that invoice's ship-to, the hold is released and invoice moves to collection.
4) Evidence upload options: secure email to finance@redwood.com (preferred for now) or via our billing portal link (see related_links).

Action for SmallBatch to avoid delays: please send either the shipto_mapping.csv (format: shipto_id,street,city,state,zip,EIN,certificate_id) or the signed affidavit. If they want us to proactively accept the PDF certificate across all ship-tos without mapping, we need a signed letter on company letterhead confirming that the certificate applies to all current and future ship-tos — we do not accept that informal confirmation without signature.

Lauren Bishop
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Jared — confirmed receipt of the CSV and the signed affidavit (thanks). Lauren, Finance verified the CSV mapping against the invoice ship-to values and has cleared the hold on INV-9931. Jared — you should see INV-9931 move to payment status in the billing portal within 24 hours.

Next steps we agreed internally:
- We will keep the certificate on file for all current ship-tos mapped in your CSV. If you add new warehouse addresses, please upload an updated CSV or sign an amendment letter.
- For any future orders that are split into multiple invoices, our system will automatically check the ship-to against the mapping; no additional action should be necessary unless the ship-to is unmapped.
- If you prefer a faster sign-off next time, I can send a DocuSign link for the affidavit amendment — let me know and I'll initiate.

Thanks again — glad we could get this cleared.

Hannah Schmitt
